title: Enduring Faith
story:
A marathon runner trained for months to complete a long race.

On the day of the event, the weather was hot and the path was difficult.

Many runners slowed down. Some even stopped halfway.

There were moments when he felt like giving up.

His legs were tired. His strength was fading.

But he reminded himself why he started.

Step by step, he kept moving forward.

He did not focus on the pain. He focused on the finish line.

After a long and exhausting run, he finally crossed it.

Waiting for him was a medal, a reward for his perseverance.

In life, we also face trials that test our strength.

There are moments when we feel like giving up.

But when we continue to trust God and move forward in faith, He strengthens us.

And in the end, there is a reward far greater than anything in this world.

A crown of life, promised by God Himself.
life_lesson:
Trials are not meant to break you, but to strengthen your faith.

When you persevere with trust in God, there is a reward waiting beyond the struggle.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Give me strength to endure every trial I face.

When I feel weak, remind me to trust You.

Help me not to give up, even when the journey feels hard.

Strengthen my faith and guide my steps.

Thank You for the promise of eternal life for those who love You.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
What trial are you facing right now?

Are you tempted to give up, or are you holding on in faith?

How can you rely on God's strength to keep moving forward?
verse:
Blessed is the one who perseveres under trial.
Because having stood the test, that person will receive the crown of life.
Which God has promised to those who love Him.
